title: Wayback CDX → Markdown input
description: Provide page URL(s) and/or domain(s). The Actor queries the Wayback Machine CDX index, selects snapshots, fetches HTML, and extracts Markdown with trafilatura.

urls.title: Page URLs
urls.description: Exact page URLs to look up in the Wayback CDX index (e.g. https://example.com/about). Paste a list or upload a text file.

domains.title: Domains (prefix / wildcard)
domains.description: Optional. Bare domains or hostnames (e.g. example.com). Queried as `example.com/*` so CDX returns archived paths under that host. Use Max snapshots carefully — large sites have huge CDX result sets.

fromDate.title: From date (Wayback)
fromDate.description: Earliest snapshot timestamp prefix (YYYY, YYYYMM, YYYYMMDD, or full YYYYMMDDhhmmss). Passed to the CDX `from` parameter.

toDate.title: To date (Wayback)
toDate.description: Latest snapshot timestamp prefix (same formats as From date). Passed to the CDX `to` parameter.

collapse.title: Collapse
collapse.description: CDX `collapse` to reduce near-duplicates. `timestamp:8` ≈ one per day, `timestamp:6` ≈ one per month, `digest` = unique content digests, `none` = no collapse (can be huge).

uniquesOnly.title: Uniques only (dupecount=0)
uniquesOnly.description: When the CDX API returns dupecount, keep only rows with dupecount=0 (waybackpack `--uniques-only`).

statusCodes.title: HTTP status codes
statusCodes.description: Keep only CDX rows whose statuscode is in this list. Empty = keep all codes.

mimeTypes.title: MIME type substrings
mimeTypes.description: Keep CDX rows whose mimetype contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive). Empty = no MIME filter. Default keeps HTML-ish captures.

selection.title: Snapshot selection
selection.description: After filters, which snapshots to fetch: `latest` (newest first), `oldest` (oldest first), or `sample` (evenly spaced across the filtered list).

maxSnapshotsPerTarget.title: Max snapshots per URL/domain
maxSnapshotsPerTarget.description: Cap how many snapshots are fetched for each input URL or domain after filters/selection.

maxItems.title: Max Markdown items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many successfully extracted snapshot rows (0 = no limit). Also caps cost.

fetchRaw.title: Fetch raw archived bytes (id_)
fetchRaw.description: Use Wayback `id_` flag so the Machine returns the original capture without toolbar rewriting (waybackpack `--raw`). Recommended for extraction.

outputFormat.title: Output
outputFormat.description: `items`: one dataset row per extracted snapshot. `chunks`: RAG chunk rows + a short per-snapshot summary row. `items_and_chunks`: both full items and chunk rows.

includeComments.title: Include comment sections
includeComments.description: Pass include_comments to trafilatura (default off — usually noise on archived pages).

favorPrecision.title: Favor precision (less boilerplate)
favorPrecision.description: trafilatura favor_precision=True — less noise, possibly less text.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size
chunkSize.description: Maximum chunk size (unit below). Used when Output includes chunks.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap
chunkOverlap.description: Trailing context repeated at the start of the next chunk.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for CDX and snapshot HTTP requests.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for Wayback CDX / snapshot fetches (waybackpack Session max_retries).

delaySecs.title: Delay between snapshot fetches (seconds)
delaySecs.description: Polite pause between snapshot body downloads. CDX queries are not delayed.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Optional. Wayback asks tools to identify themselves (include a contact). Default mentions waybackpack + this Actor.
